data.body_html:
Choosing between the Astondoa 40 and the Fairline Targa 12M for your Marbella charter? Both are top-tier sport cruisers departing from Puerto Banús, but they cater to slightly different needs. The Astondoa 40 (12.5m, 9 pax) offers all-inclusive Tier A pricing at €749 for 2 hours, while the Fairline Targa 12M (12m, 10 pax) requires a custom quote via WhatsApp. This comparison breaks down dimensions, capacity, pricing, and onboard experience to help you decide which boat suits your group best.

Dimensions and Capacity

The Astondoa 40 measures 12.5 metres in length and carries up to 9 passengers. The Fairline Targa 12M is slightly shorter at 12 metres but can accommodate 10 guests. That one extra seat makes the Fairline ideal for groups of 10, while the Astondoa is perfect for 9 or fewer. Both boats are designed for day trips along the Marbella coastline, from Puerto Banús to Cabopino or Estepona.

Pricing: Fixed vs Flexible

The Astondoa 40 is part of our Tier A pricing: €749 for 2 hours, €1,149 for 4 hours, €1,649 for 6 hours, and €2,299 for 8 hours. All prices include skipper, fuel, drinks, snacks, insurance, and VAT. The Fairline Targa 12M has pricing on request — simply message us on WhatsApp for a custom quote based on your preferred duration and season. This flexibility can work well if you want a bespoke itinerary.

Onboard Experience and Layout

The Astondoa 40 is a sporty open cruiser with a spacious sunpad aft and a comfortable cockpit. The Fairline Targa 12M offers a more enclosed cabin and a larger cockpit area, making it better for cooler days or longer cruises. Both have ample seating and a bimini top for shade. The Fairline's cabin includes a small galley and berth, while the Astondoa focuses on day-use comfort.

Inclusions: What You Get

Every charter from Boat Rental Marbella includes a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and 21% VAT. No hidden extras. For the Astondoa 40, these are baked into the fixed price. For the Fairline Targa 12M, they are included in the custom quote.

Best Use Cases

  • Astondoa 40: Ideal for groups of up to 9 who want a straightforward, all-inclusive booking with transparent pricing. Great for a 2-hour sunset cruise or a full-day exploration to Cala del Faro.
  • Fairline Targa 12M: Perfect for groups of 10, or anyone wanting a slightly more enclosed cabin space. Flexible pricing suits those who want a custom duration or itinerary.

Local Itineraries

Both boats depart from Puerto Banús. Popular routes include cruising past the Golden Mile, anchoring at Cala Cortés for swimming, or heading to Cabopino for lunch. The skipper knows the best spots for snorkelling and sightseeing, including views of La Concha mountain.

Which One to Choose?

If you value fixed pricing and a sporty open layout, go with the Astondoa 40. If you need capacity for 10 or prefer a more enclosed cockpit, the Fairline Targa 12M is your match. Both deliver a premium Marbella charter experience. For more options, explore our full fleet or contact us via WhatsApp for a custom quote.

The Astondoa 40 follows Tier A pricing: €749 for 2 hours or €2,299 for 8 hours, all inclusive. The Fairline Targa 12M has pricing on request via WhatsApp, so it may vary based on season and duration. Contact us for a custom quote.

Yes. The Astondoa 40 offers fixed 2-hour, 4-hour, 6-hour, and 8-hour slots. For the Fairline Targa 12M, you can request any duration via WhatsApp, and we'll tailor a package to your needs.

What is included in the charter for both boats?

Both charters include a licensed skipper, fuel, water, soft drinks, beer, white wine, cava, light snacks, insurance, safety equipment, and Spanish VAT (21%). No hidden fees.

The Fairline Targa 12M accommodates 10 passengers, one more than the Astondoa 40's 9. If you have a group of 10, the Fairline is the better choice. For 9 or fewer, either boat works.

Both the Astondoa 40 and Fairline Targa 12M depart from Puerto Banús, the glamorous marina in Marbella. You can also arrange pick-up from Marbella Marina or other nearby spots on request.
